$comment: Owning contract: contracts/decision-packet.schema.json per ROADMAP.md §0.4, Paper IV §6.6. Decision packet — the single artifact of an approval moment (glossary: Decision packet, RD-4). DRAFT 0.1 — built 2026-10-21 on HgX's order; awaiting ratification. Normative on ratification only.

claimed_outcome.description: Outcome the decision claims for the work item. INVARIANT (Paper III): a decision packet cannot claim 'completed' if required tests failed or a critical gap remains. Enforced by verification logic; declared here because JSON Schema cannot cross-reference the evidence packet

decision.description: The operator's recorded verdict (glossary: Approval decision)

intent_digest.description: Digest echo: the digest AS PRESENTED to the operator. Server validates DigestOf(intent) = tap_digest = this value before recording (PO-3, INV-A5)

server_recorded_at.description: Server-recorded timestamp. Together with the digest echo this is the definition of 'authoritative' (INV-A5): recorded by the server, digest-matched, timestamped

title: DecisionPacket
